set.mp.title: Multiplayer — share the images
set.mp.sub: WebStreamer downloads the images from each player's PC: they must be able to reach this server.
set.mp.switchHint: The admin interface stays private: this port only serves the screen images.
set.mp.portHint: Open / forward it on your router, firewall or tunnel (playit.gg…).
set.mp.urlHint: The address players use to reach this port. It is used to build the copied addresses.
set.mp.lan: This machine's addresses on your local network (to play over LAN):
set.mp.testNote: The test runs from this server: it checks that the address responds, not that the port is open from the Internet (router, firewall). Test from another network to be sure.
set.acc.title: Interface access
set.acc.all: All machines on the network (password required)
set.acc.noPassword: Without a password, access from other machines is refused.
set.acc.passwordHint: Any user name. Sent in clear over HTTP: on the Internet, put an HTTPS proxy in front.
set.acc.trustHint: Turn off if you tunnel the interface port: even local access will ask for the password.
set.acc.adminUrlHint: Optional: opened by the H key / the pause menu button for operators.

set.adr.title: Addresses and images
set.adr.queryHint: Without the “?”. WebStreamer caches one image per exact address; a parameter tells two addresses apart. Example: refresh=1. Leave empty for none.
set.adr.placeholder: “NO SIGNAL” image for screens without an image
set.adr.placeholderHint: Off: the screen answers “not found” and WebStreamer retries every 30 s, then shows the image as soon as it is assigned. On: the waiting image is cached by WebStreamer as long as the address does not change.
set.adr.maxUpload: Maximum size of an uploaded image (MB)
set.adv.title: Advanced
set.adv.hint: Changing a port restarts the web server; if the new port is busy, the previous settings are restored.
